# Brazil

Region: South America. Sources verified 2026-10-11. Scope follows source documentation, not assumed nationwide CAMT availability.

## Country / regional references

### Banco Central do Brasil

**Role:** Central bank / SPI-Pix infrastructure authority

**Reporting coverage:** ISO 20022 fundtransfer study and Pix message development;052/053 not established

**Messages / versions:** ISO20022 fundtransfer/Pix; exact reporting message IDs not verified

- [ISO 20022 informationcentre](https://www.bcb.gov.br/estabilidadefinanceira/ISO20022) — availability; public-page
- [Pix forum message governance](https://www.bcb.gov.br/estabilidadefinanceira/forumpagamentosinstantaneos) — availability; public-page

The 2018 study mapped 256 SPB messages to 13 ISO messages and concluded that the standard was suitable with changes. The Pix message group defines ISO 20022 messages for SPI. The historical study does not establish that all current SPB payments or corporate statements use CAMT.
